content.title: Definition of FAMOUS
content.text: Synonyms of famousnext 1 a : widely known a restaurant famous for its French cuisine b : honored for achievement Synonyms of famous Choose the Right Synonym for famous renowned implies more glory and acclamation. one of the most renowned figures in sports history celebrated implies notice and attention especially in print. the most celebrated beauty of her day noted suggests well-deserved public attention. notorious frequently adds to famous an implication of questionableness or evil. distinguished implies acknowledged excellence or superiority. a distinguished scientist who won the Nobel Prize eminent implies even greater prominence for outstanding quality or character. the country's most eminent writers illustrious stresses enduring honor and glory attached to a deed or person. Examples of famous in a Sentence a book about some of the most famous people of the last century the review gushed that the restaurant offered some truly famous Southern-style cooking Recent Examples on the Web Examples are automatically compiled from online sources to show current usage.
